facets.description: GroupTest.java:139–157: The reader is never joined before asserting, so late exceptions are missed and the thread can outlive the test.
GroupTest.java:139–157: No read overlapping deletion is guaranteed; the reader loop may never execute, allowing a vacuous pass.
GroupTest.java:152–155: deletedAll is not set in a finally block, so a throwing removal leaves the non-daemon reader looping forever and hangs the test.
